en.manifest.name: Cognia Office
en.manifest.description: Plugin-owned native XLSX authoring, preview, validation, export, and Lark Sheets synchronization.
en.renderer.name: Cognia Office Workbook
en.preview.parseError: This artifact is not a valid Cognia workbook: {error}
en.preview.loadError: The workbook preview could not load: {error}
en.importer.name: Excel workbook
en.importer.description: Import an XLSX workbook into the Cognia Office workbook model.
en.finding.featureUnsupported.remediation: Export to a new file only after confirming that this feature may be lost.
en.feature.macros: Macros are present and will not be preserved when this workbook is exported.
en.feature.pivotTables: Pivot tables are present and cannot be edited or preserved losslessly.
en.feature.charts: Complex charts are present and cannot be edited or preserved losslessly.
en.feature.externalLinks: External workbook links are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.drawings: Embedded images or drawing shapes are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.comments: Cell comments are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.tables: Structured tables are present and will be flattened to plain cell ranges.
en.feature.slicers: Slicers or timelines are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.connections: External data connections are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.controls: Form or ActiveX controls are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.conditionalFormatting: Conditional formatting is present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.dataValidation: Cell data validation rules are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.hyperlinks: Cell hyperlinks are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.sheetProtection: Sheet protection is present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.legacyDrawings: Legacy comment drawings are present and will not be preserved.
en.feature.uninspectable: The workbook package could not be inspected for unsupported OOXML features.

headless.reason: Office file open/save requires an interactive browser or Tauri file port.

mobile.reason: Workbook authoring, preview, and Lark sync work on mobile; XLSX import uses the system file picker and exports are saved to Documents/cognia/exports on the device.
